page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c40g1.10xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, providing 40 dedicated virtual CPUs across 20 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system includes 155.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, relying on external network-attached block devices, and operates with a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations indicate distinct workload characteristics across processing units. Single-core CPU performance falls into lower performance percentiles, demonstrated by a Geekbench single-core score of 934.0 and gzip compression throughput of 19.22 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded CPU tasks achieve midrange results, marked by a Geekbench multi-core score of 9161.0, a PassMark CPU score of 27268.93, and 29537.99 in multi-core stress-ng tests. Memory throughput registers average values, reaching 99.06 GB/sec for large un-cached reads and 42.71 GB/sec for large writes.

The integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers its strongest performance in machine learning inference pipelines. The instance achieved top-tier throughput in prompt processing for both 135M models (8345.57 tokens/sec) and 7B models (1129.54 tokens/sec). Generation throughput on 7B models reached 32.93 tokens/sec. The 16 GB frame buffer restricts execution of 70B parameter models on a single device, setting a hardware ceiling on large-scale model serving. Redis operations registered at 27.75 million operations per second, with static web serving throughput measured at 20.32 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn6i-c40g1.10xlarge balances a dense CPU allocation and substantial memory footprint with an entry-level inference accelerator. Organizations running parallel CPU tasks paired with small-to-medium deep learning models benefit from the co-located GPU without incurring the costs of flagship enterprise training silicon. The lack of local storage requires planning for cloud block storage latency. This instance is best suited for small-to-medium model inference, video transcoding, visual computing, and GPU-assisted analytical pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c40g1.10xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing and machine learning inference. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 40 dedicated vCPUs, 20 physical cores, and 155 GB of system memory. It incorporates a single NVIDIA T4 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM and provides 10 Gbps baseline network throughput without local instance storage. Benchmark tests reflect modest single-core CPU throughput alongside reliable multi-core processing, with PassMark scores reaching 27268.93. The NVIDIA T4 GPU excels particularly in inference preprocessing, generating over 1129 tokens per second for 7B models and over 8345 tokens per second for 135M models. With its balanced core-to-memory ratio and dedicated graphics accelerator, this instance is suited for deep learning inference, batch video processing, computer vision tasks, and concurrent analytics workloads.
